en: A sepia-toned postcard showing the front façade of a crematorium building with a prominent arched entrance, flanked by columns, and an ornate round window above the entrance. The architecture is early 20th-century, with a small tower on the left. At the top, printed German text reads 'Hirschberg i. Schl. - Das Krematorium.' A blue stamp overlays this with the name 'JELENIA GÓRA.'
